Rebase Change

⚠️
Merge Conflict Detected
This change currently has merge conflicts with its target branch. Rebasing may require checking "Allow merge conflicts" to create conflict markers for resolution.
⚠️
Not Based on Latest Parent
Parent change has an updated patchset. Rebasing will update to the latest revision.
ℹ️
Parent Merged
Parent change was merged. Recommended: Rebase on parent branch.
Suggested bases:
Creates conflict markers in file contents if the change cannot rebase cleanly.
Rebases all descendant changes in the relation chain onto this rebased change.
💡 Rebasing uploads a new patchset onto the selected base branch or commit.

Abandon Change

Abandoning this change removes it from active review. You can restore it later if needed.
↺

Restore Change

Restoring this change re-opens it for active review and submission.
↺

Revert Change

Reverting this change will create a new change that undoes its modifications.
🔔 Notification policy: OWNER only (guaranteed by Gerrit guardrail b/567559614).
🚧

Mark as Work in Progress

Marking this change as Work in Progress hides it from reviewer dashboards and pauses review requests while you make changes or resolve feedback.
✓

Mark as Active / Ready for Review

Marking this change as active moves it out of Work in Progress and notifies reviewers that it is ready for review.

Cherry Pick Change to Another Branch

⚠️
Merge Conflict Advisory
This change has merge conflicts on its source branch. Consider checking "Allow merge conflicts" below to create conflict markers if the cherry-pick cannot apply cleanly.
ℹ️
Same Branch Notice
Destination branch is the same as the source branch. Cherry-picking will create an independent duplicate change on this branch.
Suggestions:
Base Suggestions:
Creates merge conflict markers in file contents if the patch does not apply cleanly.
Copy original reviewers and CC list to the new cherry-picked change.
💡 Cherry-picking creates a new change on the target branch containing this revision's patch.

⚡ Query Syntax Tips
ANDImplicit between spaces: status:open owner:self
ORSeparate alternatives: owner:self OR reviewer:self
NOTPrefix with minus: -is:wip or -is:reviewed
( )Group expressions: (owner:self OR reviewer:self) status:open
" "Quotes for phrases: message:"fix crash"
